about:
About this property

Total Environment Tangled up in Green Plots is the new luxury Plots development project right on Doddaballapura – Devanahalli Main Road, North Bangalore. The massive residential enclave, Total Environment Tangled up in Green Plots is spread across over 110 acres of lush greens and features the very best of Total Environment’s quality construction as a plotted development project for the first time in North Bangalore. The project offers spacious 1200, 1500, and 2400-size plots with luxurious features. Beautiful landscapes, a tree museum, acres of open spaces, 8+ acres of eucalyptus forest, a central boulevard, and lush green environs all around Total Environment Tangled up in Green Plots make it more special and elite. The builder, Total Environment Landcraft is guaranteed to bring a quality and healthy living experience to the community of Devanahalli with brilliant architecture and an equivalent lifestyle in Total Environment Tangled up in Green Plots while providing access to the renowned Total Environment construction & development services.
